# std.process

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Subprocesses (run on the blocking pool) and process control.

## Types

### `Output`

```lang
pub type Output = { status: Int, stdout: String, stderr: String }
```

### `Runner`

```lang
struct Runner { programs: List<String> }
```

Permission to run the named programs, and no others: a capability the
entry module of a restricted project can hand out.

#### `Runner.run`

```lang
fn run(self: &Self, program: String, args: List<String>) -> Result<Output, io.Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Run an allowed program to completion, capturing its output.

#### `Runner.run_input`

```lang
fn run_input(self: &Self, program: String, args: List<String>, input: String) -> Result<Output, io.Error> !{Io, Wait}
```

Run an allowed program with `input` as its standard input.

## Functions

### `allow`

```lang
fn allow(programs: List<String>) -> Runner !{Io}
```

A capability running only `programs` (compared by the name given to
`run`, so allow `"git"` or `"/usr/bin/git"` as it will be called).

### `exit`

```lang
fn exit(code: Int) -> Never !{Io}
```

Exit the process immediately with `code`.
